title: StrangeLuckyBlock21
description: This mode is a lot of fun, especially if you want to fight fairly.
body:
Hi, this mod is inspired by the original LuckyBlock mod, in this mod one block in particular is notable for its incredible so-called gifts. This mod is a lot of fun for people who like small mods that don't take up too much space and resources in your minecraft world. This mod focuses on simplicity and enjoyment while playing with this mod.I named the mod StrangeLuckyBlock because I liked it. It only took me 2 hours and 30 minutes to make this mod, it was hard but worth it, I worked on this project alone, no one gave me the idea, I created it myself. This mod is different from the original LuckyBlock mod in that this mod is not available in new versions, it means only mostly some old versions, so there are some incompatibilities, and it doesn't give all the things that exist in the Minecraft world.
My mod is original in that it has:
1.You can have everything in the world
2.It's very entertaining in many ways
3.Only one Block
4.You have to be lucky to get something very valuable
5.There are no bugs or crashes
6.It's available in newer versions
7.Doesn't take up much space on your computer
8.You can do a lot of things with this mod
9.A great adventure in search of that lucky block
10.There's a lot of fun here

This image shows how to actually make the StrangeLuckyBlock, this is just a little help on how to actually make the block. It's not too difficult, but it does require you to find the necessary resources first.
